query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ca.status FROM collection_actions ca INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ca.receivableId LEFT JOIN collection_manual_ticks cmt ON cmt.receivable_id = ca.receivableId WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < '2026-05-11T00:00:00' AND cmt.id IS NULL ORDER BY ar.cliente LIMIT 20;
